name: Butter Chicken with Spinach, Cilantro & Baked Cauliflower Rice

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the spinach if it came pre-washed.)
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ medium heads cauliflower
3 (1 inch) pieces ginger root
1 small bunch cilantro
1 ½ (5 oz) pkgs baby spinach

instructions.primary_message: Cut each cauliflower head into quarters; using a box grater, hold stem end of the cauliflower and coarsely grate. (Alternatively, transfer cauliflower to the bowl of a food processor; pulse until rice-like in consistency.) Divide between two large baking sheet pans and spread out in an even layer.
Season cauliflower rice with salt and pepper. Cut butter into small pieces and sprinkle over top.
Place baking sheets in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast, stirring cauliflower rice halfway through, until tender and golden, about 15-20 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, preheat a large pot over medium-high heat.
While the pot heats up, peel, halve, and small dice onions.
Once the pot is hot, add butter and swirl to coat the bottom. Add onion and cook, stirring occasionally, until golden and tender, 4-5 minutes.
Meanwhile, pat chicken dry with paper towels, then cut into bite-sized pieces. Season with salt and pepper.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 ¼ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless
salt
black pepper

instructions.primary_message: When the onion is done, add chicken to the pot; cook, stirring occasionally, until golden, 6-7 minutes.
While the chicken is cooking, using a clean cutting board, peel and mince ginger and garlic. Place both in a small bowl.

Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl with the ginger and garlic, along with tomato paste, water, garam masala, and crushed red pepper. Stir to combine the spice paste.
instructions.secondary_message:
6 tbsp tomato paste
2 tbsp garam masala
¾ tsp crushed red pepper

instructions.primary_message: When the chicken is done, add spice paste to the pot and stir to coat. Add broth and cream, then stir to combine and bring to a simmer. Once simmering, reduce heat to medium-low and continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until curry has thickened, 12-15 minutes more.
instructions.secondary_message:
12 fl oz (1 ½ cups) chicken or vegetable broth
12 fl oz (1 ½ cups) heavy whipping cream

instructions.primary_message: When the curry has thickened, add spinach to the pot in handfuls, waiting for the leaves to wilt slightly before adding the next handful. Stir to combine and remove from heat.
To serve, divide cauliflower rice and butter chicken between plates or bowls. Enjoy!
